snippet.title: Carry The Glass 2.0 - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:

The biggest update yet is here!
Experience completely overhauled mechanics, a brand new 2-hour level, improved glass-carrying gameplay, fresh cosmetics, new achievements, and competitive leaderboards. Whether you’re a returning player or joining for the first time, there’s never been a better time to play!
